title: towards a linked open index: reconciling museum records to wikidata for index of american design constituents
core_idea: Reconcile thousands of constituent records from a museum collection management system for the Index of American Design with Wikidata using OpenRefine, examine methodological challenges (incomplete/inconsistent identifiers, conflicts between local records and Wikidata, and aligning diverse roles beyond artists), and explore strategies plus a linked Power BI approach to monitor data quality, access, and representation in the humanities.
tldr: A project to create a linked open index by reconciling museum CMS records for the Index of American Design with Wikidata, investigating reconciliation challenges and workflows, and proposing monitoring via a linked Power BI tool.
